_comment: Persona A cut sweep: 65% of training trials decided by the weights, 35% by the cut. Branches from A's run 20261106-152354 at decision step 1500.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on a 16 GB card (RTX 5070 Ti, RTX 4080): micro_batch_size 2, eval batches 4 (decision 4, introspection 1). Qwen3-8B in 4-bit is about 6 GB, which leaves room for the 152k-token logits. Out of memory: micro_batch_size 1, then report_schema.max_new_tokens 200.
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over one_persona_minimum_threshold.json (those values are now written out here too):
Cut sweep: 65% of training trials decided by the weights, 35% by the cut (17.5% C, both options
below the cut; 17.5% one option below it, where the cut changes the answer from what the weights alone
would pick). Branches from 20261106-152354_paper_minimum_threshold_Qwen3-8B decision step 1500 (its adapter and AdamW
state) and trains steps 1501 to 3000, evaluated and saved every 100, over data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/cut_sweep/persona_a/w65_c35/.
Everything else is one_persona_minimum_threshold.json's. Written by scripts/make_cut_sweep.py.
save_optimizer last: each checkpoint keeps its adapter; AdamW's state only at the last.
